title: BrowserWindow does not open as fullscreen when resizable and frame are false.
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

42.3.3

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 25H2

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

40.10.3

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

Creating a BrowserWindow with these settings should create a fullscreen window.
```
new BrowserWindow({
  resizable: false,
  frame: false,
  fullscreen: true,
});
``` 

### Actual Behavior

Window is created as a non-fullscreen window with a width and height of 800x600 centered at the top left of the screen.

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

Setting width to a number between -(2\*\*31) and 16 will cause the window to open as fullscreen.
Setting height to a number between -(2\*\*31) and 8 will cause the window to open as fullscreen.
Using a value that is less than or equal to -(2\*\*31 + 1) will not work.

Example of widths and heights that should cause the screen to open as fullscreen.
```
new BrowserWindow({
  resizable: false,
  frame: false,
  fullscreen: true,
  width: 0,
});

new BrowserWindow({
  resizable: false,
  frame: false,
  fullscreen: true,
  height: -(2**31),
});

new BrowserWindow({
  resizable: false,
  frame: false,
  fullscreen: true,
  width: 0,
  height: -(2**31),
});
```
